notes.title: A new game, " Moonlight thief ", is on sale.
notes.notes:
Hello! 
The moonlight thief developed for 3 years was released in late April.
It is a game of infiltrating the mansions of the nobles and the steal goods from them to return it common people, and finding clues about the enemy who killed his parents. 

Both games and OST are on sale at the steam store.
Please enjoy the game! :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1006830/Moonlight_thief
